item.title: Seychelles coral lab dives into spawning success
item.description: The first successful coral-spawning event has taken place at a new land-based laboratory on Praslin Island in the Seychelles. The Coral Spawning Lab, set up in partnership with Canon EMEA and Nature Seychelles, managed to produce 800,000 embryos through controlled sexual reproduction and then settle 65,000 new corals.
